As a praise to the lord, I am happy to bring this English Bible application for iOS devices. Having felt that, there is no common version of English  Bible in the app store. This application has been planned & developed for a complete English version with New King James & International (Used in earlier catholic church).

This app contains both "Old Testament" and "New Testament" in English. 

*Easily Jump to Verse in Chapter with verses conveniently on top of each Chapter 
 * Share verses with friends using social networks( Facebook/Twitter), email, or SMS (text).
